ClientResponses.Response: We are sorry to hear about the vast disappointment with your new Spirit II E-210. We certainly do not expect this and would like to offer some grilling tips! We suggest allowing your grill to preheat with both burners on high and the lid closed for 20 minutes. This will allow the heat to regulate throughout the inside of your grill. If you would prefer a low heat, we suggest turning one burner off after preheating and grill on the side with the burner off during the first moments, and when you are ready to pull the food out, place it on the side with the burner on to create sear marks and lock in the juices! If you continue to experience issues or would like additional tips, please do not hesitate to contact us. We are always ready to help! Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: Don’t buy it.  The amount of heat is grossly inadequate, the heat distribution is uneven, and it is impossible to get a good sear without overcooking the inside of what whatever you are cooking.

Results.ReviewText: Handsome look.  Good size cooking surface and gets hot quickly. However, I believe that there is a design defect that does not allow the tank scale to get an accurate reading of the remaining  propane because tank rests on wheel axle instead of allowing the tank to fully drag the scale down. I deducted two stars. I also have a 13 year old Genesis so I know what I am talking about. When I called customer service they were clueless. Said they would send new scale but it has never arrived. My daughter bought the same model with the same problem.
Results.Title: Possible Design defect needs rectification.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: We have owned weber grills for many years, our last being a Genesis which we loved, but we had to move from Florida to Ohio and sold the grill with the house.  We compared grills from different manufacturers but the quality of a Weber is very good.  This particular model heats quickly and has sufficient room for the amount we grill.  One small issue is that it is only on 2 wheels which makes it difficult to move around since the side table is foldable, you cannot use that to pick up the end without the wheels.  That basically is the only reason it does not get 5 stars, but we should have thought of that before purchase.  Another nice feature is that the store has them pre-assembled, so all that has to be added is that propane tank.
Results.Title: Top Quality Grill

Results.ReviewText: Grill seems to work great. Just used it for the first time today on the 4th of July. Giving it 3 stars because assembly was problematic. Got seven steps in and hit a roadblock. A major part was shaped incorrectly and was impossible to configure with other parts. After navigating to a customer service rep over the phone, which led to no resolution, I had to spend a lot of time documenting the issue through photos and writing to send an email to Weber. They sent me a new part, but it took three weeks to get to me. With the new part on hand I proceeded to continue assembly. I got the job done, but encountered two or three other instances of parts not quite being shaped right to fit into each other. In these cases I had to manually bend the parts to fit correctly. There was clearly a quality control issue, at least with my grill.
Results.Title: Frustrating assembly experience

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
